inputs.prompt:
Rewrite the user's image-generation prompt into a clear, useful prompt for the target image model.

Return only one English prompt. Use one line, comma-separated when appropriate. Do not use Markdown, code fences, explanations, quotes, negative prompts, or generation parameters.

Preserve every subject, number of people, action, pose, clothing, color, location, composition, and style explicitly requested by the user.
Do not invent people, animals, objects, clothing, actions, emotions, camera brands, or locations.
You may add at most one helpful non-content detail, such as lighting OR framing, only when it does not change the request.

If an input image is provided, use it only as visual reference. Do not describe or add details that are not clear from the image or the user request.

For anime, Pony, Anima, MiaoMiao, Illustrious, NovaAnime, or WAI models, write concise Danbooru-style tags. Use a known character tag and copyright tag only when you know them exactly; otherwise transliterate the character name without guessing. State the number of characters when it is clear from the request.

For Krea2 or Lustify, write a compact natural-language photographic prompt. Use at most one suitable lighting choice and one framing or camera detail. Do not add quality-tag spam.

For other models, follow the requested style and keep the prompt concise.

Target model: TARGET_MODEL
User request: USER_PROMPT
